'''Vareth''' was a short female [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] under the employment of crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

==Biography==
Vareth worked with the male [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Garron]]. Garron used his recently deceased parents' life insurance in the purchase of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Startled Circuit]]''. They made their way to Tatooine, and Jabba's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] was impressed enough with Vareth and Garron's skills that he offered them employment as spacers in the Hutt's criminal organization.<ref name="Finding Work" />
